solutions.python:
# 鏈表節點定義
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next

class Solution:
    def reverseList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        """
        方法一：迭代
        時間複雜度: O(n)
        空間複雜度: O(1)
        """
        prev = None
        current = head
        
        while current:
            # 保存下一個節點
            next_node = current.next
            # 反轉當前節點的指標
            current.next = prev
            # 移動指標
            prev = current
            current = next_node
        
        return prev
    
    def reverseList_recursive(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        """
        方法二：遞迴
        時間複雜度: O(n)
        空間複雜度: O(n) - 遞迴堆疊
        """
        # 基礎情況
        if not head or not head.next:
            return head
        
        # 遞迴反轉後續鏈表
        new_head = self.reverseList_recursive(head.next)
        
        # 反轉當前節點
        head.next.next = head
        head.next = None
        
        return new_head
